childperm.bg_title: Keep sharing when the screen is off
childperm.bg_disclosure: Nirapod collects your location to share it with your family, alert them when you arrive at or leave places, and send SOS, even when the app is closed or not in use. Only your family circle can see it. It is never sold or used for ads.
childperm.bg_hint: On the next screen choose "Allow all the time".
childperm.battery_title: Don't let the battery saver stop sharing
childperm.battery_body: Some phones stop apps in the background. Set Nirapod to "No restrictions".
childperm.brand_xiaomi: Settings > Apps > Nirapod > Battery saver > No restrictions. Also turn on Autostart.
childperm.brand_oppo: Settings > Battery > App battery management > Nirapod > Allow background activity.
childperm.brand_vivo: Settings > Battery > Background power consumption > Nirapod > Allow.
childperm.brand_realme: Settings > Battery > App battery management > Nirapod > Allow background activity and Auto launch.
childperm.brand_samsung: Settings > Apps > Nirapod > Battery > Unrestricted. Remove Nirapod from Sleeping apps.
childperm.brand_other: Settings > Apps > Nirapod > Battery > Unrestricted (or "Don't optimize").
